 Inspiration 

 After all these years where all things are looking more and more the same, we started craving the times where we had UI and hardware with more identity and single purpose. 

 webPod explores what a music player UI could absorb from the iPod Video era and enable this experience for humans and agents. 

 What it does 

 Connect to your Apple Music and Spotify and enjoy the dose of nostalgia, either directly interacting or using an agent as proxy for you. 

 How we built it 

 Using HTML in canvas and other modern web APIs. Thanks Chrome Team and (Modern Web Guidance)[ https://developer.chrome.com/docs/modern-web-guidance ]
